requirements: R1: The door controller starts in the Locked state with the door secured.
R2: When a valid badge is scanned while in Locked under normal access mode, the door unlocks and the controller moves to UnlockedTimed.
R3: When the unlock timer expires while in UnlockedTimed, the controller relocks the door and returns to Locked.
R4: When an invalid badge is scanned while in Locked, the controller must remain Locked, deny access, and record a denied-access event.
R5: When a valid PIN is entered on the keypad while in Locked, the controller unlocks the door and moves to UnlockedTimed.
R6: When a fire alarm signal is activated in any state, the controller unlocks the door immediately and moves to FireUnlock.
R7: When the fire alarm signal is cleared while in FireUnlock, the controller relocks the door and returns to Locked.
R8: When an authorized remote lock command is received while in UnlockedTimed, the controller relocks the door immediately and returns to Locked.
R9: When two-person access control is enabled and a first valid badge is scanned while in Locked, the controller moves to AwaitingSecondBadge without unlocking.
R10: When a second valid badge is scanned within ten seconds while in AwaitingSecondBadge, the controller unlocks the door and moves to UnlockedTimed.
R11: When the ten-second waiting period expires without a second badge while in AwaitingSecondBadge, the controller returns to Locked.
R12: When a forced-door-open sensor activates while in Locked, the controller moves to Alarm and emits an intrusion alert.
R13: The controller must not unlock the door under normal access rules unless either a valid single-badge access, a valid PIN entry, or a valid two-badge sequence occurs.
